name: Eógan mac Néill

attributes.attribute: strong stone fort of the kingship

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Eógan mac Néill was a son of the great king Niall of Tara. He founded the kingdom of Tyrone, also called Tir Eógan. The kingdom lay in the province of Ulster. He set up a kingship at the stone stronghold of Grianán Aileach. That kingship began in the fifth century.

okr.objective: Rewrite the Eógan mac Néill entry with its kingship.
key_results: Parent him to Niall of the Nine Hostages

Set the kingship at Grianán Aileach in the 5th century
